items.title_en: This blog is written in en-GB
items.title_zh: 本博客以英式英语（en-GB）撰写
items.summary_en: A note clarifying that the blog uses en-GB spelling and style, explaining the reasons for sticking with British English. It may discuss readers in international contexts and how the choice affects tone and accessibility.
items.summary_zh: 该博文说明本博客使用英式英语（en-GB），并采用相应的拼写与标点规范。作者解释了偏好此变体的理由，以及对国际读者的影响。

items.title_en: AI can't be listed as inventor on patent applications, Japan's top court rules
items.title_zh: 日本最高法院裁定 AI 不能作为发明人列入专利申请
items.summary_en: Japan's top court rules AI can't be listed as inventor on patent applications. That means humans must be named as inventors, keeping a clear line between human ingenuity and AI contributions with implications for IP governance.
items.summary_zh: 日本最高法院裁定 AI 不能作为发明人出现在专利申请中，意味着发明人必须是人类。这对 AI 辅助的发明及未来的知识产权治理有现实影响。

items.title_en: Android Developer Verification: Threat masquerading as protection
items.title_zh: Android 开发者验证：伪装成保护的威胁
items.summary_en: Android developer verification can be abused by threat actors who disguise malware as protective or security tools. Such tactics exploit trust signals around security features to mislead users or bypass vetting, undermining platform defenses. The takeaway is a push for tighter vetting, clearer indicators of app behavior, and user skepticism when apps claim to protect you.
items.summary_zh: Android 开发者验证可能被威胁者利用，伪装成保护性工具的恶意软件。此类手段利用安全功能的信任信号误导用户或规避审核，削弱平台防护。要点在于加强审核、提供更清晰的应用行为指示，并提高用户在遇到自称保护工具的应用时的警惕。

items.title_en: AI fake news complaining about how AI fake news is the death of real news
items.title_zh: AI 假新闻抱怨 AI 假新闻才是现实新闻的死亡
items.summary_en: AI fake news complaining about how AI fake news is the death of real news
items.summary_zh: 一篇观点指出 AI 生成的假新闻正在侵蚀真实新闻的信任，探讨 AI 在信息生态中的双重角色与治理挑战。

items.title_en: The primary purpose of code review is to find code that will be hard to maintain
items.title_zh: 代码评审的主要目的是发现难以维护的代码
items.summary_en: The primary purpose of code review is to find code that will be hard to maintain
items.summary_zh: 代码评审的核心在于发现会带来维护困难的代码，强调可维护性、可读性和长期架构的健康。

items.title_en: The Egg Bandits Made a Thousand Times the Fine They Just Paid for Price Fixing
items.title_zh: 蛋商价格操纵案：罚款远不及利润
items.summary_en: The Egg Bandits Made a Thousand Times the Fine They Just Paid for Price Fixing
items.summary_zh: 蛋商的价格操纵案中，所缴罚款远低于由此获得的利润，凸显执法力度与激励之间的落差。

items.title_en: Vite+ Beta
items.title_zh: Vite+ Beta 版
items.summary_en: Vite+ Beta
items.summary_zh: Vite+ 的 Beta 版本发布，带来对开发体验、构建性能及工具生态的改进，进一步巩固了 Vite 的生态地位。

items.title_en: Launch HN: Manufact (YC S25) – MCP Cloud
items.title_zh: Launch HN：Manufact（YC S25）—— MCP Cloud
items.summary_en: Manufact, a YC S25 startup, unveils MCP Cloud, a cloud-based platform to run manufacturing control workflows. The move signals a shift toward cloud-native tooling in hardware, aiming to simplify configuration and scaling of production lines.
items.summary_zh: Manufact，一家 YC S25 支持的制造业初创，推出 MCP Cloud，将云端用于运行制造控制工作流，意在简化配置和扩展生产线。此举体现了硬件领域对云原生工具的日益依赖。

items.title_en: Show HN: ZeroFS – A log-structured filesystem for S3
items.title_zh: Show HN：ZeroFS——面向 S3 的日志结构文件系统
items.summary_en: ZeroFS is a log-structured filesystem for S3. It uses a log-structured approach atop S3, enabling append-only writes and efficient compaction for object storage workloads.
items.summary_zh: ZeroFS 在 S3 之上实现日志结构文件系统，采用追加写入与高效整理的方式，提升对象存储场景下的写入效率与管理性。

items.title_en: Germany’s Infineon opens major chip plant as EU seeks tech autonomy
items.title_zh: 德国英飞凌在欧盟推动科技自主之际开设大型芯片工厂
items.summary_en: Germany’s Infineon opens major chip plant as EU seeks tech autonomy
items.summary_zh: 英飞凌在欧盟推动科技自主之际开设一座大型芯片工厂，体现欧洲加强半导体供给自主性的战略意图。

items.title_en: Since Linux 6.9, LUKS suspend stopped wiping disk-encryption keys from memory
items.title_zh: 自 Linux 6.9 起，LUKS 休眠不再从内存擦除磁盘加密密钥
items.summary_en: Linux 6.9 introduced a change where LUKS suspend no longer clears in-memory keys, trading security for faster resume. The decision highlights the ongoing tension between safeguarding encryption keys and preserving usability in sleep states.
items.summary_zh: 自 Linux 6.9 起，LUKS 休眠不再从内存中清除磁盘加密密钥，提升恢复速度的同时扩大了内存中密钥暴露的风险。这一取舍凸显了在安全性与可用性之间的持续权衡。

items.title_en: Show HN: Mail Memories – A desktop app to rescue photos from Gmail
items.title_zh: Show HN：Mail Memories——一款用于从 Gmail 恢复照片的桌面应用
items.summary_en: Mail Memories is a desktop app to rescue photos from Gmail. It offers offline access and organized recovery of photo attachments, making long-forgotten memories retrievable.
items.summary_zh: Mail Memories 是一款桌面应用，用于从 Gmail 中救回照片，提供离线访问与有序恢复照片附件的功能，帮助找回久被遗忘的记忆。

items.title_en: Winamp Skin Museum
items.title_zh: Winamp 皮肤博物馆
items.summary_en: Winamp Skin Museum
items.summary_zh: Winamp 皮肤博物馆收集与呈现早期 UI 自定义的传统与演变，记录数字文化的一个小历史。

items.title_en: How to ask for help from people who don't know you
items.title_zh: 如何向不认识你的人寻求帮助
items.summary_en: How to ask for help from people who don't know you
items.summary_zh: 向陌生人寻求帮助的实用指南，强调在提请求时清晰地说明背景、对方能获得的价值以及具体目标，以提升回应率。

items.title_en: Bring back crappy forums
items.title_zh: 让糟糕论坛卷土重来
items.summary_en: A retrospective argues for reviving the rough-and-tumble forum culture that predates modern platforms—less polish, more candid discussion, and simpler moderation. It examines what early forums did well and what modern networks could borrow, from lightweight threading to signal-to-noise management.
items.summary_zh: 该文回顾并主张让糟糕但充满活力的论坛文化回归——强调直率讨论、低门槛与简化的社区治理。它讨论早期论坛的优点，以及现代社群应借鉴的经验，如简化的主题讨论与信号噪声管理。

items.title_en: Kimi K2.7 Code is generally available in GitHub Copilot
items.title_zh: Kimi K2.7 代码现已在 GitHub Copilot 中广泛可用
items.summary_en: GitHub Copilot now broadly supports Kimi K2.7 code, expanding access to advanced AI-assisted coding capabilities. This milestone signals the maturing ecosystem for AI copilots, with implications for how developers source, trust, and review AI-generated code, alongside licensing and privacy considerations.
items.summary_zh: GitHub Copilot 现已广泛支持 Kimi K2.7 代码，扩展了对高级 AI 代码助手的使用。此里程碑标志着 AI 助手生态的成熟，影响开发者对 AI 生成代码的获取、信任与审查，以及相关的许可和隐私问题。

items.title_en: Is One Layer Enough? A Single Transformer Layer Matches Full-Parameter RL Train
items.title_zh: 一层就够吗？单层 Transformer 就能匹配全参数 RL 训练
items.summary_en: Is One Layer Enough? A Single Transformer Layer Matches Full-Parameter RL Train
items.summary_zh: 研究表明，在特定设置下，单层 Transformer 也能达到与全参数 RL 训练相当的效果，挑战了对深度的普遍依赖观。对模型设计与训练成本具有启示。

items.title_en: The fall of the theorem economy
items.title_zh: 定理经济的衰落
items.summary_en: The piece argues that the so-called theorem economy, which prioritizes formal proofs and guarantees, may be losing its primacy in tech and science. It advocates pragmatic engineering, testing, and real-world outcomes over pursuit of perfect formal guarantees.
items.summary_zh: 文章认为以形式化证明和保证为核心的“定理经济”可能正在失去主导地位。倡导务实的工程实践、测试与实际结果，避免过度追求完美的形式化保证。

items.title_en: Oomwoo, an open-source robot vacuum you build yourself
items.title_zh: Oomwoo：一个你自己组装的开源机器人吸尘器
items.summary_en: Oomwoo is an open-source, build-it-yourself robot vacuum kit that lets hobbyists swap hardware and customize software. It showcases the growing maker movement around home robots, providing transparent designs, firmware, and code. Community-driven projects like this push for accessible robotics and faster iteration.
items.summary_zh: Oomwoo 是一个可自行组装的开源机器人吸尘器套件，允许用户定制硬件与软件。它体现了家用机器人开源潮流，通过透明的硬件、固件与代码促进社区协作与快速迭代。这样的项目降低入门门槛，推动更多爱好者参与硬件创新。

items.title_en: For first time, a cell built from scratch grows and divides
items.title_zh: 首次从零构建的细胞能够生长并分裂
items.summary_en: Researchers have built a cell from scratch that can grow and divide, marking a milestone in bottom-up synthetic biology. By assembling functional cellular life from individual components, the work advances the dream of programmable biology and could unlock new biotechnologies and origins-of-life insights. Yet, challenges around stability, safety, and control remain as researchers push toward more complex designs.
items.summary_zh: 研究者首次从零构建出可生长和分裂的细胞，标志着自下而上的合成生物学里程碑。通过从单个组件组装功能性细胞生命，这项工作推动了可编程生物学的实现，并可能为生物技术和起源研究带来新机遇。当然，稳定性、安全性与可控性仍是未来进一步复杂化设计时需要面对的挑战。

items.title_en: ZCode – Harness for GLM-5.2
items.title_zh: ZCode：GLM-5.2 的测试套件
items.summary_en: ZCode releases a harness for GLM-5.2, offering an end-to-end toolkit to run prompts, collect metrics, and compare outputs. This reduces the friction of experimentation and makes benchmarking more reproducible for ML researchers and developers.
items.summary_zh: ZCode 推出 GLM-5.2 的测试套件，提供从输入到结果评估的一体化工具，便于执行提示、收集指标和对比输出。降低研究者的试验门槛，便于可重复的基准比较。

items.title_en: Claude Code is steganographically marking requests
items.title_zh: Claude Code 以隐写方式标记请求
items.summary_en: Researchers demonstrate how Claude Code can embed hidden signals in prompts, enabling steganographic tagging of requests. This raises questions about model privacy, misuse, and provenance in AI-assisted workflows. The finding highlights the need for robust controls around prompt encoding.
items.summary_zh: 研究者展示了 Claude Code 如何在提示中嵌入隐写信号，给请求标记隐藏标识。这引发对模型隐私、滥用和工作流可追溯性的担忧，凸显了对提示编码的鲁棒控制的必要性。

items.title_en: OpenAI ‘in early talks to give 5% stake to US government’
items.title_zh: OpenAI 正在就向美国政府转让约 5% 股权进行初步谈判
items.summary_en: OpenAI ‘in early talks to give 5% stake to US government’
items.summary_zh: 据报 OpenAI 正在就向美国政府转让约 5% 股权进行早期谈判，引发关于治理与政府影响力的讨论。

items.title_en: Spain Orders Blacklist of Palantir from Public and Private Companies
items.title_zh: 西班牙将 Palantir 列入公私部门黑名单
items.summary_en: Spain Orders Blacklist of Palantir from Public and Private Companies
items.summary_zh: 西班牙对 Palantir 的公私部门使用实施黑名单，反映对数据隐私与监控技术的监管关注。

items.title_en: PeerTube is a free, decentralized and federated video platform
items.title_zh: PeerTube 是一个免费、去中心化且联邦化的视频平台
items.summary_en: PeerTube is a free, decentralized and federated video platform
items.summary_zh: PeerTube 提供一个免费、去中心化且联邦化的视频平台，强调社区主机与隐私保护，体现对大型中心化平台的替代愿景。

items.title_en: Physical disc production ending in Jan 2028 for new games on PlayStation
items.title_zh: PlayStation 将于 2028 年 1 月停止新作实体光盘生产
items.summary_en: Sony will end physical disc production for new PlayStation releases in January 2028, accelerating its digital-first strategy. The move reduces manufacturing and distribution costs but may affect collectors, retailers, and regions with stronger physical markets. It signals a lasting shift in how console games are distributed and consumed.
items.summary_zh: 索尼将于 2028 年 1 月停止新作实体光盘的生产，进一步推动数字化优先策略。此举降低了制造与发行成本，但可能影响收藏者、零售商以及实体市场较强的地区，预示着主机游戏发行与消费方式的长期转变。

items.title_en: Show HN: CLI tool for detecting non-exact code duplication with embedding models
items.title_zh: Show HN：使用嵌入模型检测非精确代码重复的 CLI 工具
items.summary_en: CLI tool for detecting non-exact code duplication with embedding models
items.summary_zh: 一个 CLI 工具使用嵌入模型检测语义相近但非完全相同的代码重复，帮助开发者在重构时发现潜在重复。

items.title_en: Show HN: A graph paper generator that renders vector PDFs in the browser
items.title_zh: Show HN：一个在浏览器中渲染矢量 PDF 的方格纸生成器
items.summary_en: Show HN: A graph paper generator that renders vector PDFs in the browser
items.summary_zh: 一个在浏览器中生成并导出矢量 PDF 的方格纸生成器，支持自定义网格尺寸，便于离线打印使用。

items.title_en: Sony Deletes 551 Movies PlayStation Owners Paid For
items.title_zh: 索尼删除了 PlayStation 用户购买的 551 部电影
items.summary_en: Sony reportedly removed 551 StudioCanal titles from PlayStation libraries, affecting owners who thought they had purchased those films. The incident underlines how digital ownership hinges on licensing and can disappear with rights changes. It raises questions about the permanence of digital libraries and consumer protections.
items.summary_zh: 据报导，索尼从 PlayStation 库中移除了 551 部 StudioCanal 的电影，影响了以为自己购买过的用户。事件凸显数字所有权依赖于许可，权利变更就可能导致内容消失。引发对数字馆藏永久性与消费者保护的思考。

items.title_en: Show HN: Searchable directory of 22k+ products from worker-owned co-ops
items.title_zh: Show HN：员工共同所有制合作社的2.2万+件产品可检索目录
items.summary_en: A searchable directory aggregating over 22,000 products from worker-owned co-ops, making ethically produced goods easier to discover. The project lowers barriers for consumers and researchers to support cooperative businesses and study their impact.
items.summary_zh: 一个聚合了来自员工共同所有制合作社的2.2万多件产品的可检索目录，帮助用户更容易发现符合伦理的商品。该项目降低了消费者与研究者支持合作社企业的门槛，并便于研究其影响。

items.title_en: Fable 5 is Back
items.title_zh: Fable 5 又回来了
items.summary_en: A tease that Fable 5 is back, hinting at refreshed capabilities and improved tooling for creative tasks like writing and coding. Early signals suggest better context handling and expanded integration with other AI features.
items.summary_zh: Fable 5 再次亮相，暗示将带来升级的能力和更强的创作工具，包括写作与编码任务的改进。初步信息显示会提升上下文处理和与其他功能的协同。

items.title_en: What to learn to be a graphics programmer
items.title_zh: 成为图形程序员要学什么
items.summary_en: A practical roadmap that covers the fundamentals: math (linear algebra, vectors, matrices), GPU pipelines, shading languages, and APIs (OpenGL/Vulkan/DirectX). It emphasizes building real projects (ray tracers, small engines) and a portfolio to demonstrate skill progression, plus tips on debugging shader code.
items.summary_zh: 这篇实用路线图列出成为图形程序员的核心要点，包括线性代数等数学基础、GPU 管线、着色语言以及 OpenGL/Vulkan/DirectX 等 API。作者建议以小型引擎或光线追踪实现等实战项目来积累作品集，附带调试着色器的实战要点。

items.title_en: Department of Commerce has lifted export controls on Claude Fable 5 and Mythos 5
items.title_zh: 商务部取消对 Claude Fable 5 与 Mythos 5 的出口管制
items.summary_en: The Department of Commerce has eased export controls on Claude Fable 5 and Mythos 5, enabling broader international distribution. The move could accelerate global AI deployment and competition, while inviting regulatory and security considerations.
items.summary_zh: 商务部放松了对 Claude Fable 5 和 Mythos 5 的出口管制，使其在全球范围内的分发更为广泛。这一举措可能加速全球 AI 的部署与竞争，同时带来监管与安全方面的考量。

items.title_en: Asahi Linux 7.1 Progress Report
items.title_zh: Asahi Linux 7.1 进展报告
items.summary_en: Asahi Linux 7.1 delivers new kernel improvements, broader Apple Silicon support, and performance tweaks aimed at making Macs run Linux more smoothly. The update narrows hardware gaps and enhances stability for everyday use and development on Apple hardware. It signals ongoing momentum for Linux on consumer devices.
items.summary_zh: Asahi Linux 7.1 的进展包括内核改进、对 Apple Silicon 的更广泛支持以及性能优化，旨在让在 Mac 上运行 Linux 更加顺畅。此次更新缩小了硬件兼容性差距、提升了日常使用与开发的稳定性，继续推动 Linux 在消费级设备上的应用。

items.title_en: CursorBench 3.1
items.title_zh: CursorBench 3.1 发布
items.summary_en: CursorBench 3.1 arrives with updated workloads and more realistic, reproducible benchmarks for measuring cursor input latency and UI responsiveness. The update helps developers and hardware teams compare input performance more reliably across platforms.
items.summary_zh: CursorBench 3.1 带来更新的工作负载和更真实、可复现的基准，用于衡量光标输入延迟和界面响应。新版本帮助开发者和硬件团队在不同平台间更可靠地比较输入性能。

items.title_en: Comparing Fable and 10 other LLMs on refactoring a LangGraph god node
items.title_zh: 在对 LangGraph 的神经节点进行重构时，对比 Fable 与其他 10 种 LLM 的表现
items.summary_en: Comparing Fable and 10 other LLMs on refactoring a LangGraph god node
items.summary_zh: 对 Fable 与另外十种大型语言模型在 LangGraph 关键节点重构任务上的表现进行对比，揭示不同模型在代码相关任务中的差异。

items.title_en: Box3D, an open source 3D physics engine
items.title_zh: 宣布发布 Box3D：开源的 3D 物理引擎
items.summary_en: Box3D arrives as an open-source successor in 3D physics engines, following Box2D lineage. It aims to deliver robust rigid-body dynamics with a modular design and easier integration for games and simulations, inviting community contributions. If you build 3D physics into your project, Box3D could become a go-to option without licensing friction.
items.summary_zh: Box3D 作为 3D 物理引擎的开源继任者加入，沿袭 Box2D 的传统，目标是提供健壮的刚体动力学、模块化设计以及更易的集成，鼓励社区贡献。若你的项目需要 3D 物理，这个引擎可能成为无许可负担的首选选项。

items.title_en: FFmpeg 9.1's new AAC encoder
items.title_zh: FFmpeg 9.1 的新 AAC 编码器
items.summary_en: FFmpeg 9.1 introduces a new AAC encoder with improved encoding quality and efficiency, offering better stereo handling and options for low-latency workflows. The update may influence streaming pipelines and compliance considerations for AAC encoding in media workflows.
items.summary_zh: FFmpeg 9.1 带来全新的 AAC 编码器，提升了编码质量和效率，并在立体声处理与低延迟工作流方面提供改进。此更新对媒体工作流中的 AAC 编码兼容性与流式传输管线可能产生影响。

items.title_en: Opening up 'Zero-Knowledge Proof' technology to promote privacy in age assurance
items.title_zh: 开放零知识证明技术以提升年龄认证隐私
items.summary_en: Google outlines opening up zero-knowledge proof technology to improve privacy in age verification, enabling platforms to prove age without exposing birth dates or identity details. This shift could unlock privacy-preserving access controls in social apps and e-commerce.
items.summary_zh: Google 提出开放零知识证明技术以提升年龄认证中的隐私保护，使平台在不暴露出生日期或身份信息的情况下证明用户年龄。此举可能为社交、电子商务等场景带来隐私友好且可验证的准入控制。

items.title_en: Vibe Coded X11 Server Written in Rust Adds Xinerama, FreeBSD Support
items.title_zh: 用 Rust 编写的 Vibe Coded X11 服务器新增 Xinerama 与 FreeBSD 支持
items.summary_en: Vibe Coded X11 Server Written in Rust Adds Xinerama, FreeBSD Support
items.summary_zh: 用 Rust 编写的 Vibe Coded X11 服务器新增 Xinerama 多显示与 FreeBSD 兼容性，体现 Rust 在底层工具中的应用拓展。

items.title_en: Senior SWE-Bench: open-source benchmark that assesses agents as senior engineers
items.title_zh: Senior SWE-Bench：开源基准评估 AI 代理作为资深工程师的能力
items.summary_en: The Senior SWE-Bench is an open-source benchmark that evaluates AI agents as if they were senior software engineers, covering tasks from design to debugging and code review. It helps gauge progress of coding assistants against real-world software tasks and sets a higher bar for reliability. By providing standardized scenarios, it guides development and evaluation of AI coding tools.
items.summary_zh: Senior SWE-Bench 是一个开源基准，评估 AI 代理在软件工程领域的资深水平，如系统设计、调试与代码评审。通过对现实世界任务的测评，帮助衡量代码助手的进展并提升可靠性标准。标准化的场景为 AI 编码工具的开发与评估提供指引。

items.title_en: Monetization Gateway: Charge for any resource behind Cloudflare via x402
items.title_zh: 货币化网关上线
items.summary_en: Cloudflare launches Monetization Gateway, a centralized service to monetize online content through payments, gating, and access control. It streamlines revenue workflows for publishers, reducing integration friction and enabling more consistent monetization across sites. The product highlights the industry’s move toward turnkey monetization tools for the open web.
items.summary_zh: Cloudflare 推出 Monetization Gateway，提供一个集中化服务，通过支付、门控和访问控制来实现内容变现。它简化了出版商的收入工作流，降低集成难度，并实现跨站点更一致的变现。该产品凸显了在线内容领域向“端到端”变现工具的趋势。

items.title_en: Weave Robotics launches Isaac 1, a $7,999 home robot with Fall 2026 deliveries
items.title_zh: Weave Robotics 发布 Isaac 1 家用机器人，售价 7999 美元，2026 年秋季交付
items.summary_en: Weave Robotics unveils Isaac 1, a home robot priced at $7,999 with fall 2026 deliveries, signaling an ambitious consumer robot roadmap with AI-enabled assistance.
items.summary_zh: Weave Robotics 发布 Isaac 1 家用机器人，售价7999美元，计划2026年秋季交付，展示其面向家庭的 AI 协作功能。

items.title_en: NSA tries to weaken mlkem standardisation
items.title_zh: NSA 企图削弱 MLKEM 标准化进程
items.summary_en: NSA tries to weaken mlkem standardisation
items.summary_zh: 据称国家安全局试图削弱 ML-KEM 等标准化进程，引发关于开放标准与国家安全之间的辩论。

items.title_en: We Don't Have to Be This Bad at Improving Society
items.title_zh: 改善社会不必如此糟糕
items.summary_en: The piece critiques performative tech won't-change narratives and urges more grounded, humane approaches to societal improvement. It emphasizes measurable impact, collaboration, and systems thinking over grandiose promises.
items.summary_zh: 文章批评表面化的技术改善叙事，呼吁采取更务实、以人为本的社会改进方式。强调以实际影响、协作和系统性思考取代空洞承诺。

items.title_en: Ask HN: Who is hiring? (July 2026)
items.title_zh: Ask HN：谁在招聘？（2026年7月）
items.summary_en: A community-sourced thread where engineers post openings and recruiters surface opportunities; signals in July 2026 include AI/ML roles, cloud infra, Rust/Go, and remote-friendly positions across time zones.
items.summary_zh: 这是一个社区聚合贴，工程师们发布职位空缺，招聘方也在帖中列出机会。7 月 2026 的招聘热点包括 AI/ML、云基础设施、Rust/Go 相关岗位，以及支持远程工作的机会。

items.title_en: Healthy but sedentary people show early decline in cellular energy production
items.title_zh: 健康但久坐的人群细胞能量产生出现早期下降
items.summary_en: Healthy adults who lead sedentary lives show early declines in cellular energy production, signaling mitochondrial function may deteriorate before metabolic markers change. This underscores that even apparent health can be compromised by inactivity.
items.summary_zh: 即使是健康但久坐的成年人，也会出现细胞能量产生的早期下降，提示线粒体功能在代谢指标改变之前就受到影响。这强调了久坐对健康的隐性风险。

items.title_en: The Underhanded C Contest
items.title_zh: 暗箱 C 竞赛
items.summary_en: The Underhanded C Contest is a long-running programming challenge that invites writers to craft C code with intentional, harmless deception to test compilers and readers. It highlights clever quirks and how code can be both creative and deceptive, underscoring the importance of readability and security.
items.summary_zh: Underhanded C Contest 是一个长期的编程挑战，鼓励人们用有意的、无害的误导来编写 C 代码，以考验编译器与读者的警觉性。它揭示了语言特性与编译器的边界，既考验创造力，也提醒关注可读性与安全性。

items.title_en: Qualcomm Linux 2.0
items.title_zh: 高通 Linux 2.0 发布
items.summary_en: Qualcomm announces Linux 2.0, a major update broadening Linux support across Snapdragon platforms with new drivers, tooling, and security/performance improvements. The release emphasizes open-source collaboration and easier developer onboarding for embedded and mobile hardware.
items.summary_zh: 高通宣布 Linux 2.0 发布，扩大对 Snapdragon 平台的 Linux 支持，并带来新驱动、工具链和改进的安全与性能。此版本强调开源协作以及在嵌入式与移动硬件上更便捷的开发者上手体验。

items.title_en: Orbital Data Centers: Why the Hype Outpaces Reality
items.title_zh: 轨道数据中心：热潮为何超过现实
items.summary_en: Orbital Data Centers: Why the Hype Outpaces Reality
items.summary_zh: IEEE Spectrum 指出轨道数据中心的热潮超出现实可行性，成本、维护与可操作性等挑战仍然存在。

items.title_en: How We Made IPFS Content Publishing 10x Faster
items.title_zh: 我们让 IPFS 内容发布快了 10 倍
items.summary_en: Probelab explains how IPFS publishing was sped up by roughly 10x using Optimistic Provide and related optimizations. The approach reduces latency by proactively distributing blocks and improving availability across peers. It showcases practical strategies to scale decentralized content delivery.
items.summary_zh: Probelab 介绍如何通过 Optimistic Provide 等优化将 IPFS 内容发布速度提升约 10 倍，提前分发数据块并提高对等节点的可用性以降低延迟。这展示了在去中心化内容分发中实现可扩展性的实用策略。

items.title_en: Google loses fight over record $4.7B EU antitrust fine
items.title_zh: 谷歌就欧盟创纪录的47亿欧元反垄断罚款上诉败诉
items.summary_en: The EU’s antitrust ruling against Google stands after an appeal, highlighting ongoing regulatory pressure on tech giants in Europe. The decision reinforces the EU’s willingness to enforce competition rules in digital markets.
items.summary_zh: 欧盟对谷歌的反垄断裁决在上诉后维持，凸显欧盟对科技巨头持续施压的监管态势。此决定重申欧盟在数字市场执行竞争规则的意愿。

items.title_en: The <Usermedia> HTML Element
items.title_zh: HTML 元素 <Usermedia>
items.summary_en: Chromium blog announces the UserMedia HTML element, standardizing access to cameras and microphones with a unified API and permission model. This could simplify embedding user media in web apps and improve privacy UX.
items.summary_zh: Chrome 团队宣布引入 UserMedia HTML 元素，为相机和麦克风等用户媒体的访问提供统一的 API 与权限模型。此举可能简化网页嵌入媒体的实现，并提升隐私与权限体验。

items.title_en: ArXiv's Next Chapter
items.title_zh: ArXiv 的下一章
items.summary_en: ArXiv outlines its plan for the next chapter, focusing on governance, tooling improvements, and sustainable operations. The post emphasizes scaling moderation, API enhancements, and community governance to support open-access research.
items.summary_zh: ArXiv 公布未来发展路线，聚焦治理、工具改进与长期可持续运营。文章强调扩大内容审查与元数据/API 的改进，以及社区治理，以支持开放获取的研究。

items.title_en: Ask HN: Who wants to be hired? (July 2026)
items.title_zh: Ask HN：谁想被雇佣？（2026年7月）
items.summary_en: A counterpart to the 'who is hiring' thread focusing on job seekers announcing availability, often highlighting short-term gigs, remote roles, and in-demand skills across AI, cloud, and systems programming.
items.summary_zh: 与‘谁在招聘’相对，这条贴子聚焦求职者公布求职意向，常见包含短期工作、远程岗位，以及 AI、云计算、系统编程等领域的需求。

items.title_en: Chip Off The Old Block
items.title_zh: 芯片的传承：从旧传统到新设计
items.summary_en: Chip Off The Old Block analyzes how modern chip design borrows from legacy architectures, weighing implications for efficiency, resilience, and continued relevance of older ideas.
items.summary_zh: 本文探讨现代芯片设计如何借鉴并演化传统体系架构，评估其在效率、鲁棒性以及延续旧思想方面的影响。

items.title_en: Why jet engines aren't made in China
items.title_zh: 为何喷气发动机不会在中国大规模生产
items.summary_en: Jet engine production requires precision manufacturing, certification, and a global supply chain; building full-scale jet engine manufacturing domestically is costly and complex, explaining why it's not common in China.
items.summary_zh: 喷气发动机的生产依赖于高精密制造、严格认证和全球化的供应链，国内要建立完整产能成本高、周期长，因此难以在短期内实现大规模本土化生产。

items.title_en: Hanami 3.0: In Full Bloom
items.title_zh: Hanami 3.0：全面绽放
items.summary_en: Hanami 3.0 arrives with modular architecture refinements, faster boot, and ergonomic APIs for Ruby apps, signaling maturity for production Rails-like workloads.
items.summary_zh: Hanami 3.0 带来模块化架构优化、启动更快以及更友好的 API，提升 Ruby 应用的生产力和可维护性。

items.title_en: Learn Vim motions with an ice-cream van
items.title_zh: 用冰淇淋车学 Vim 移动键位
items.summary_en: An engaging Vim motion tutorial framed around an ice-cream van theme, turning abstract keystrokes into memorable, visual lessons. It offers practical tips for practicing and internalizing common Vim motions.
items.summary_zh: 以冰淇淋车为主题的 Vim 移动快捷键教学，将抽象的按键操作变成易记的直观课程，提供实用的练习与记忆技巧。

items.title_en: Mortality associated with non-optimal ambient temperatures from 2000 to 2019
items.title_zh: 与 OPNsense 的远程执行漏洞之追踪：我的首批 CVE 故事
items.summary_en: A security write-up recounts chasing an OPNsense RCE vulnerability, detailing discovery, exploit chain, and lessons for responsible disclosure.
items.summary_zh: 安全博客讲述追踪 OPNsense 的远程代码执行漏洞的过程，涵盖发现、利用链及负责任披露的经验教训。

items.title_en: How do wombats poop cubes? (2021)
items.title_zh: 袋熊的便便为何呈立方体形状
items.summary_en: Researchers explain that wombats form cube-shaped droppings due to long gut transit time, dehydration, and contraction of intestinal muscles, which create flat sides. The cube shape helps prevent rolling and aids in territorial marking and stacking.
items.summary_zh: 研究者解释袋熊的便便为何呈立方体形状：肠道迁移时间长、脱水以及肠道肌肉收缩使排泄物干燥成形。立方体便便便于标记领地并叠放，避免滚落。

items.title_en: Launch HN: Parsewise (YC P25) – Reason Across Documents with an API
items.title_zh: Parsewise（YC P25）上线：通过 API 实现跨文档推理
items.summary_en: Parsewise offers an API to reason across documents, enabling applications to query and derive insights from a corpus rather than a single file. This enables smarter document intelligence for teams dealing with large document collections, from research to knowledge bases. Developers can integrate multi-document Q&A, search, and summarization workflows.
items.summary_zh: Parsewise（YC P25）提供通过 API 对跨文档进行推理的能力，使应用能够从一个文档集合中提取见解，而非局限于单篇文档。这为需要处理大量文档的团队带来更智能的文档分析能力，适用于研究和知识库等场景。开发者可以将多文档问答、搜索与摘要等工作流接入到应用。

items.title_en: LibreCAD in the Browser
items.title_zh: 浏览器中的 LibreCAD
items.summary_en: LibreCAD now runs in the browser via WebAssembly, enabling instant CAD work without desktop installs. This reflects the broader move of CAD and design tools to the web.
items.summary_zh: LibreCAD 现已通过 WebAssembly 在浏览器中运行，使用户无需桌面安装即可进行 CAD 工作，体现了 CAD/设计工具向 Web 的迁移趋势。

items.title_en: Newly discovered spider builds spring loaded snare to catch ants
items.title_zh: 新发现的蜘蛛用弹簧陷阱捕蚁
items.summary_en: A newly documented spider uses a spring-loaded snare to catch ants, showcasing a novel predation strategy in arachnids. The rapid, mechanical trap highlights evolved specialization and could inspire bio-inspired trap design in engineering.
items.summary_zh: 研究人员发现一种新蜘蛛，利用弹簧式陷阱捕捉蚂蚁，这是一种罕见的捕食策略。其快速的机械捕捉机制体现了进化的专业化，并可能为生物启发的捕捉装置提供灵感。

items.title_en: Show HN: Claudoro, Pomodoro timer embedded in the Claude Code statusline
items.title_zh: Show HN：Claudoro 将 Pomodoro 番茄钟嵌入 Claude Code 状态栏
items.summary_en: Show HN: Claudoro, Pomodoro timer embedded in the Claude Code statusline
items.summary_zh: Claudoro 将番茄钟直接嵌入 Claude Code 的状态栏，为在 Claude 里编码的开发者提供专注工具。

items.title_en: The Apple Disk II Controller Card (2021)
items.title_zh: Apple Disk II 控制卡
items.summary_en: The Apple Disk II Controller Card revisits the hardware that made Apple II's floppy drives practical, and chronicles design quirks, compatibility challenges, and modern recreations for hobbyists.
items.summary_zh: 回顾 Apple Disk II 控制卡这一使 Apple II 软盘可用的关键外设，讲述其设计细节、兼容性挑战，以及面向爱好者的现代再现。

items.title_en: Asymmetric Quantization: Near-Lossless Retrieval with 97% Storage Reduction
items.title_zh: 非对称量化：实现近损检索，存储可减少约97%
items.summary_en: A new asymmetric quantization technique enables near-lossless retrieval while reducing storage by about 97% for embeddings. This makes large-scale vector databases more affordable and faster to query with acceptable accuracy trade-offs.
items.summary_zh: 一种新的非对称量化技术实现近损检索，嵌入向量存储量约减少97%。这使大规模向量数据库的成本显著下降，查询速度更快，精度权衡在可接受范围内。

items.title_en: My favorite keyboards
items.title_zh: 我最喜欢的键盘
items.summary_en: A personal tour of favorite keyboards, detailing feel, layout, and build considerations with practical buying tips. Readers gain insights into choosing keyboards that fit different workflows and preferences.
items.summary_zh: 一篇关于作者最喜欢的键盘的个人评述，结合手感、按键布局与做工等要点，并给出实用的选购建议。读者可以据此在不同工作流和偏好下做出选择。

items.title_en: 1-Bit Pixel Art Emojis
items.title_zh: 1 位像素艺术表情符号
items.summary_en: 1-bit pixel art emojis demonstrate extreme minimalism in glyph design, trading detail for iconic shapes. The project explores how much expression can be conveyed with a single bit, with potential uses in tiny UIs, retro games, or terminal art. It’s a playful reminder of design efficiency.
items.summary_zh: 1 位像素艺术表情符号展示了极简图形设计中的表达力极限，以极少的细节换取标志性造型。该项目探讨在单比特色彩下能传达多少情感，适用于极小的界面、怀旧游戏或终端艺术，体现了设计的高效性。

items.title_en: Database Traffic Control
items.title_zh: 数据库流量控制
items.summary_en: Planetscale introduces Database Traffic Control, a policy-driven feature to route and throttle database traffic, ensuring QoS and stability in multi-tenant deployments.
items.summary_zh: Planetscale 推出数据库流量控制，这是一个通过策略对数据库流量进行路由与节流的功能，旨在多租户部署中保障服务质量与稳定性。

items.title_en: German button maker searched rivers of American Midwest for valuable shells
items.title_zh: 德国钮扣制造商在美国中西部河流寻找珍贵贝壳
items.summary_en: German button maker searched rivers of American Midwest for valuable shells
items.summary_zh: 一位德国钮扣制造商在美国中西部河流寻找用于钮扣的珍贵贝壳，揭示了19世纪全球贸易网络与材料来源对制造业的影响。

items.title_en: WinPE as a stateless harness for Windows driver testing and fuzzing
items.title_zh: WinPE 作为无状态的 Windows 驱动测试与模糊测试框架
items.summary_en: WinPE as a stateless harness for Windows driver testing and fuzzing
items.summary_zh: 将 WinPE 用作无状态的测试环境基座，以进行 Windows 驱动测试与模糊测试，提升可重复性与隔离性。

items.title_en: The Wisdom of Quinn the Eskimo (Apple Developer Technical Support Engineer)
items.title_zh: Quinn the Eskimo 的智慧（Apple 开发者技术支持工程师）
items.summary_en: A collection of pragmatic tips and anecdotes from Quinn the Eskimo, an Apple Developer Technical Support Engineer, addressing common developer pain points and practical workarounds.
items.summary_zh: 汇集了来自 Quinn the Eskimo（Apple 开发者技术支持工程师）的实用技巧与趣闻，聚焦开发者常见痛点及可行的解决办法。

items.title_en: Natural history on canvas: Brueghel knew about bird-eating noctule bats
items.title_zh: 画布上的自然史：布鲁盖尔知道鸟食夜蝙蝠
items.summary_en: Natural history on canvas: Brueghel knew about bird-eating noctule bats
items.summary_zh: 通过布鲁盖尔的画作，将生物多样性知识与艺术史联系起来，揭示中世纪艺术对自然世界的认知。

items.title_en: Show HN: Cyclearchive.com – search vintage cycling magazines
items.title_zh: Show HN：Cyclearchive.com——检索 vintage 自行车杂志
items.summary_en: Show HN: Cyclearchive.com – search vintage cycling magazines
items.summary_zh: Cyclearchive 提供对 vintage 自行车杂志的可搜索访问，适合研究者与爱好者追溯早期自行车文化与报道。

items.title_en: The vibration of the pager has a sound all its own
items.title_zh: 寻呼机振动有它独特的声音
items.summary_en: An essay on on-call culture and alert fatigue, using pager vibration as a metaphor for triage signals. It offers actionable ideas to improve incident response and prioritization.
items.summary_zh: 以寻呼机振动的独特声音为线索，讨论在值班文化中的告警疲劳与分诊信号，并给出改进事件响应与优先级处理的可执行建议。

items.title_en: The Meadows of Medieval Summer
items.title_zh: 中世纪夏日的草地
items.summary_en: The Meadows of Medieval Summer
items.summary_zh: 探讨中世纪夏季的草地景观、耕作日历与农村生活，揭示草地如何影响经济与生态。

items.title_en: Avo 4 released – 15 months and 2000 commits later
items.title_zh: Avo 4 发布：历时15个月，2000 次提交
items.summary_en: Avo 4 launches after a 15-month, 2000-commit development cycle, bringing major enhancements to modeling, governance, and automation in the data tooling space.
items.summary_zh: Avo 4 发布，历时15个月、完成2000次提交，带来在建模、治理与自动化方面的重大改进，体现数据工具的持续迭代。
